answer: Stop sybils with a plume ferrous inlet: an agent bonds one inlet creek. Each cycle it sets one ferrous pin and hangs a plume from it; verifiers match the plume's sway to the creek chart, voiding a copied pin, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 creeks at 18x: one plume sways once at one inlet, its sway set by that current, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents hang once, keep rights.
